description.text: An extreme close view of rain-beaded bus window glass at night, clear droplets scattered across the pane with tiny wavering reflections of neon and sodium light. The glass trembles faintly with the bus's motion.
An extreme close view of rain-beaded bus window glass at night, clear droplets scattered across the pane with tiny wavering reflections of neon and sodium light.
Soft irregular tapping of rain on glass.
A faint low hum of a bus engine.
One droplet swells, breaks its surface tension, and begins to run downward, gathering smaller beads into a thin wobbling rivulet that leaves a clear trail behind it.

Beyond the wet pane, out-of-focus headlights, shop signs, and streetlamps stretch into long vertical smears and slide steadily from right to left. Rain continues striking the glass, each impact nudging the beaded surface as the runnels thicken and fork downward. The reflected colors ripple and stretch across the wet film.

A steady patter of rain on glass.
A muffled swish of passing traffic.
Rain strikes the pane and nudges the beaded surface while the runnels thicken and fork downward; reflected colors ripple and stretch across the wet film.

The dark rubber seal and metal frame of the bus window appear at the edge of the pane, with a sliver of dim bus interior along the frame. Beyond the glass, streaking city lights continue sliding past, punctuated by the occasional brighter smear of a sign. Rainwater keeps crawling down the pane in uneven lines, and reflections of the passing lights slide across the interior trim.
